description: This file defines a dispatching system with classes and functions for pattern matching, including Dispatcher and VarDispatcher classes, and functions like match, supercedes, edge, and ordering, used for pattern-based function dispatching and ordering signatures.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: A class for dispatching functions based on signatures with pattern matching and ordering.

classes.name: VarDispatcher
classes.description: A subclass of Dispatcher that handles variable names in pattern matching.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new signature-function pair to the dispatcher.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Invokes the dispatcher with given arguments, resolving the appropriate function.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the best matching signature for given arguments.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Decorator to register a function with specific signatures.
